response.consequence: Legitimate team admins or owners may be refused when adding guests to team members' bookings. Two DB queries run per request even for non-team bookings.
response.explanation: isTeamAdminOrOwner is computed as isTeamAdmin(...) && isTeamOwner(...). The name and intent are "admin or owner", but the && means the user must pass both checks. Whether a team admin who is not an owner passes depends on how isTeamOwner is implemented, and a plain owner may fail isTeamAdmin if that checks only the ADMIN role. Such users are rejected with FORBIDDEN unless they are also the organizer or an attendee. The `?? 0` fallback also runs both team queries for bookings that have no team.

other_findings.consequence: Existing attendees receive the wrong email (a fresh 'scheduled' email instead of the guests-added notice). The email logic does not respect the blacklist filter.
other_findings.explanation: Duplicate and blacklisted guests are filtered into uniqueGuests, and only uniqueGuests are saved. At the end, sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests) is called with the raw input, so newGuests includes the filtered-out addresses. Any filtered address that is already an attendee is matched in `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` and gets the 'scheduled' email instead of the 'guests added' email.
other_findings.title: Emails are sent for the unfiltered guest list, not the saved guests

other_findings.consequence: Blacklisted addresses can be added as attendees by changing their case. Direct tRPC callers can create duplicate attendees.
other_findings.explanation: The blacklist is lowercased, but each guest is compared as-is with includes(guest). 'Bad@Example.com' therefore bypasses a blacklist entry 'bad@example.com'. The same applies to the existing-attendee comparison. Duplicates within the input are also not removed on the server, since that check exists only in the client dialog, so a direct API call with the same email twice creates duplicate attendee rows.
other_findings.title: Blacklist and duplicate checks are case-sensitive and the input is not deduped

response.title: Team admin/owner authorization requires both roles (&& instead of ||)
